<entry id="A02600">
<head-word>אָפָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (contr. of אַפְעָא q. v.) 
<italic>a striped wild animal</italic> (of the genus 
<italic>felis</italic>) of which the male (stronger) and the female species are distinguished, corresp. to h. צָבוּע q. v.; 
<pgbrk id="pg100" />
<italic>leopard</italic>, and 
<italic>hyæna striata</italic> (
<italic>striped hyena</italic>).</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 16
<sup>a</sup> (expl. נפרזא leopard); ib. (expl. צבוע); v. discussion ib. Yoma 84
<sup>a</sup> א' דיכרא Ms. M. (ed. דדיכרא, corr. acc.) a male 
<italic>afa</italic>. [Not to be confounded with b. h. אֶפְעֶה, v. Nöld. M. Gr. p. 58 sq. note.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>אַפּוּכִי, </head-word>
<head-word>(אוּפְכִי, </head-word>

<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (אפך, הפך, cmp. חליפין) 
<italic>return, exchange, equivalent, settlement</italic> (cmp. esp. Targ. Prov. XXIV, 29, a. P. Sm. s. v. הפך).</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 34, end א' דידה הן היא (Yalk. Lev. 665 אִיפּוּכִין, pl.) where is the equivalent for the money spent? Ib. and of all those (praised for their deeds with 
<italic>ashré</italic>) לא נטל א' אלא זה (Yal. l. c. איפוכין) none received the promise of an equivalent except this (Ps. XLI, 2). Gen. R. s. 42 on the day of the destruction of Jerusalem נטלו ישראל אפכי Ar. (ed. אופכי) Israel received full payment for all their sins (ref. to Lam. IV, 22). Ib. א' גדולה ample, general settlement; Lam. R. l. c. א' שלימה settlement in full. [Tanḥ. Sh’moth 13, אפיפסים, corr. acc.] Num. R. s. 13; Esth. R. introd. Ruth R. introd. אופכין (corr. acc.). [Lam. R. to III, 13 אפוכי בני Mus., 
<italic>hostages;</italic> v. אֹופִיכָא]—
<plural-form>Pl. אִפֹּוכִיֹּות, אַפְכִיֹּות</plural-form>. Y’lamd. Sh’laḥ, quot. in Ar.; Num. R. s. 17 a citizen was paying 
<italic>annonae</italic> ובותב א' and writing agreements of converting (security for the case of forfeiture); v., however, אַנְפָּרוּת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A02728">

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to turn</italic> (act. a. neut.) also 
<italic>to turn around, to flee; to make turn around, to beat</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 9. Targ. I Chron. VIII, 13; a. fr.—Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>c</sup> top אפיך אפיך turn around, turn around. Men. 25
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. איפוך reverse it, or, I reverse it. Ib. ומי מצית אפכת לה how can you reverse it? Gitt. 69
<sup>b</sup> ונַפְּכֵיה let him reverse it; a. fr.—(With שבועה) 
<italic>to reverse the oath, shift the oath over to the opponent</italic>. Shebu. 41

<sup>a</sup> אפיך ליה he reversed it, i.e. recited the alphabet to him in inverted order. Yeb. 63
<sup>a</sup> א' לה he said to her just the reverse. Gitt. 67
<sup>b</sup> מֵיפַךְ אפכי they will do the reverse; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to overturn, destroy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup> דאפכיה לעלמא מרישא (Ms. M. דאחרב) that I should destroy the world.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. אִיכְפַּת) 
<italic>to have to do with, care for, mind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. Shebi. IX, 38
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Erub. III, 21
<sup>b</sup> bot. (read:) מה אפך לן פתילה גבי וכ' what does the law about wicks concern us when speaking of the egg, i.e. what relation is there between the two? Y. Ter. VIII, 46
<sup>a</sup> top מה אפך לן מִצְוֹת וכ' what relation is there between religious laws and sanitary precautions concerning snake-bitten fruit? Ib. מה אפכיי וכ' (corr. acc.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to move about, travel, traffic</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 31
<sup>b</sup> כ"ע אפכי all the people are about, on the road.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pay in return, to retaliate</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="E00740">הֲפַךְ</xref> a. 
<xref rid="A02619">אַפּוּכִי.</xref></definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְּפִיךְ, אִתְּפַךְ, </binyan-form>
<senses>

<italic>to change off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 10
<sup>b</sup> איתפוכי אתפך (old ed. correctly אתְּפוּךְ, mod. ed. אתהפוכי אתהפוך, Ms. M. והפוכי) they changed places. Deriv. אַפּוּכִי, אִיפְּכָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
